provenance: Frozen baseline recorded by the original case run on Linux, commit de33abfe52ccfee67f461a850edd00a14d2fbfaa, before this repository integration; see README.md in this directory.

dataset.name: UCI Daily and Sports Activities
dataset.feature_definition: per-segment mean then population std (ddof=0) of torso acceleration x/y/z and torso angular rate x/y/z

protocol.outer: GroupKFold(n_splits=4, shuffle=False) over original row order
protocol.final: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=20261001) on all rows
protocol.selection: unweighted mean of inner balanced accuracies; strict-greater replacement; first configuration order wins exact ties; no outer-driven selection

scope.official_uv_lock_environment_tested_note: The full case was re-run in the repository's official uv.lock environment on 2026-10-02; it reproduced the macOS parity outputs exactly and retained the same platform-associated difference against this frozen baseline. See reverification_uv_lock.json.
scope.figure_readability_issue: The native 19-class confusion-matrix export was crowded at its original default size (adjacent three-digit annotations and axis labels); numeric CSVs and metrics were unaffected. The original observation is retained here as history; the native plotting path was made class-count adaptive on 2026-10-02 and the export was re-checked.
scope.statement: Software conformance and reproducibility evidence only; no claim about algorithmic novelty, other populations, clinical use or user error reduction.
